tagline: Arsenal胶片单反相机，1965 年发布
description: Arsenal于1965年推出的胶片单反相机。

specs.英文简介: The Kiev Automat aka Kiev-10 Automat (Cyrillic inscription: Автомат or Киев-10 автомат) was manufactured in the Arsenal factory, possibly from 1965 to 1968 as Kiev Automat and from 1969 to 1974 as Kiev-10 Automat, and is perhaps one of the strangest and most innovative cameras to come from the Soviet Union.
